anime.title: Cowboy Bebop - Ballad of Fallen Angels

director.name: Shinichiro Watanabe
director.bio: Shinichiro Watanabe is a Japanese anime director known for Cowboy Bebop, Samurai Champloo, and Space Dandy. His works are celebrated for blending genres and incorporating diverse musical influences.

voiceActor.name: Koichi Yamadera
voiceActor.bio: Koichi Yamadera is a prolific Japanese voice actor known for voicing Spike Spiegel in Cowboy Bebop and numerous other iconic anime characters.

voiceActor.name: Unsho Ishizuka
voiceActor.bio: Unsho Ishizuka was a Japanese voice actor known for his deep, commanding voice, voicing Jet Black in Cowboy Bebop and Professor Oak in Pokemon.

voiceActor.name: Megumi Hayashibara
voiceActor.bio: Megumi Hayashibara is a Japanese voice actress and singer known for her roles as Faye Valentine in Cowboy Bebop and Rei Ayanami in Neon Genesis Evangelion.

voiceActor.name: Steve Blum
voiceActor.bio: Steven Jay Blum is an American voice actor best known for voicing Spike Spiegel in the English dub of Cowboy Bebop.

anime.outline: Spike's violent past catches up with him when his former partner from the Red Dragon Crime Syndicate resurfaces.
anime.description: Spike is lured into a deadly confrontation with Vicious, his former partner in the Red Dragon Crime Syndicate. As memories of his past — including his relationship with Julia — come flooding back, Spike must face the man who wants him dead. The episode is a turning point in the series, revealing the dark history that haunts Spike and establishing the central conflict that drives the show to its conclusion.
anime.soundtrack: Rain by Yoko Kanno and the Seatbelts
